no-fold.title: A hosted instance never folds a conversation and carries only the last 12 rows

web-chat-hang.title: The web chat hangs on a spawn-only turn and hides sub-agent results until a reload

glm-no-tools.title: A GLM head has no tool loop; an empty model reply becomes Done.

glm-mem-write-dropped.title: A GLM head's mem_write with the wrong field name is dropped with no log line

memory-needs-mistral-key.title: Memory is queued, not stored, on an instance with no embedding route

member-memory-write-dropped.title: A memory write from a member chat id can be dropped on a hosted instance even when the owner's writes on the same instance store (the embedding route works)

binary-read-kills-turn.title: files.read on a binary file breaks the provider request and ends the turn

noted-correction.title: A plain Noted gets (Correction: that has not been saved.)

no-web-lookup.title: No web lookup without a Tavily key

web-answer-quality.title: The Tavily answer misses the current release for this model

weak-brief-source.title: A disruption brief credits grandcentralrail.com or london-now.co.uk instead of the operator or National Rail (owner signal 5)

placeholder-reply.title: A forced final answer can deliver placeholder; the conversational cap throttles real tasks

no-routines.title: Routines do not exist on a hosted instance

no-image-path.title: A hosted instance has no image path

no-tool-trace.title: nimbusd records no tool_output rows and reports no jobs

dead-controls.title: Restart and Power off are shown on a hosted instance and do nothing

mistral-model-list.title: The Mistral picker lists foreign models and omits mistral-small-latest
